standard_prerequisites.use: Spectra of valuation rings, closures viewed as integral subschemes, and generic points of components of a fibre; the construction is retained.

core_obligations: Construct the cartesian square over the spectrum of a valuation ring with the two prescribed base points.
Verify that the chosen points lift to generic points of components of the relevant fibres, for both the intermediate and the second closure.

proof_roadmap.step: Build the valuation ring base change from the given points.
Lift y and check it is generic in the component of the fibre.
Lift x and check the same for the second closure.

difficulty_reason: Given a morphism, a point y whose closure is Y, a base point s and a generic point x of a component of the fibre of Y over s, the lemma constructs a cartesian base change to the spectrum of a valuation ring whose generic point maps to the image of y and whose closed point maps to s, and over which both y and x are realised as generic points of components of the corresponding fibres. The proof performs the base change using the valuation ring obtained by localising at the relevant prime and then tracks the two points through the change, verifying that they remain generic points of the required components. Tracking both points through the base change is the load-bearing part. Retained author proof at lines 5127-5164.
